admin.banner_description: Platform-wide management (creating new tenants, licensing, tenant→agent mapping) is not part of this view and remains with the framework operator. For data-protection reasons the operator has no read access to your case data.

admin.confirm_disable_2fa_req_desc: The user will no longer be forced to set up an authenticator on next login. Existing TOTP credentials, if any, are kept. Use this for service / test accounts that need password-grant access. In production, leave 2FA mandatory for compliance.
admin.confirm_enable_2fa_req_desc: The user will be forced to set up a TOTP authenticator the next time they log in. If they already have one configured it stays valid; only the forced-enrollment prompt is added back.
admin.confirm_reset_2fa_desc: Existing authenticator app codes are invalidated. The user will be prompted to set up a new authenticator on their next login.
admin.field_temp_password: Force password change on first login
admin.field_temporary: Temporary (user must change on next login)
admin.license_alert_expired_desc: OSINT searches will stop working until the operator renews the license. Contact your platform operator with the contact email shown below.
admin.license_alert_expiring_desc: Contact your platform operator to renew before the date above to avoid interruption.
admin.license_operator_note_desc: Renewals, key rotations, and tenant→agent re-mapping are managed by the platform operator. Reach them via the contact email above.
admin.msg_2fa_reset_none: User had no 2FA configured. Forced enrollment is now active for next login.
admin.no_admin_description: Your account doesn't have the 'admin' role. Ask an admin in your organization to grant it.
admin.settings_auto_delete_help: Closed cases get purged completely (operator metadata + customer-agent investigation data) after this many months. Empty = never. Runs daily as a scheduled job.
admin.settings_default_alert_email_help: Pre-filled when adding a new monitoring config.
admin.settings_display_name_help: Shown in the header and on report covers — e.g. "Example Agency".
admin.settings_logo_hint: PNG/JPG/SVG, max {{kb}} KB. Used in the app header and PDF report covers.
admin.settings_logo_not_image: Selected file is not an image
admin.settings_saved_kc_sync_failed: Settings saved, but the new session timeout could not be pushed to your Keycloak realm. Check the operator logs.
admin.settings_session_timeout_help: Minutes of inactivity before users are logged out. Pushed to your Keycloak realm immediately on save (ssoSessionIdleTimeout + ssoSessionMaxLifespan).
admin.subtitle: Manage your organization. All actions are scoped to the tenant shown above — other organizations are not visible.
admin.title: Tenant Admin
admin.settings_default_language_help: Interface language for every user who has not picked one in the header yet. Empty = the browser's language.
admin.settings_require_purpose: Require a purpose for every search
admin.settings_require_purpose_help: Every search and every new watch then needs a purpose or legal basis (e.g. a file number). The text is stored only in your authority's search log; if that log is unreachable, the search does not start.
admin.settings_classification_help: Printed in red at the top and bottom of every page of every PDF report, and on the cover. Empty = none.
admin.settings_classification_invalid: No quotes, backslashes or line breaks.
admin.settings_default_playbook_help: Preselected in the search form where it fits the selector type. The investigator can always deselect it.
admin.settings_disabled_modules_help: Licensed modules your authority must not use (e.g. by internal policy). They disappear from search and no longer run in existing watches either.

alerts.baseline_body: It records what is already there. Only what arrives afterwards is reported — otherwise the first run would deliver the entire search result as alerts, and an inbox that receives that once ignores the next one.
alerts.baseline_title: A monitor's first run is quiet on purpose
alerts.empty_hint: Alerts only come from an active monitor.
alerts.subtitle: What monitoring found since you last looked — across every case.
alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.unresolved: (label lives with the customer — agent unreachable)
alerts.unresolved_body: The alerts are real; only their labels live in your authority's own store, which is not answering right now. The operator deliberately does not keep a copy of the findings.

audit.intro: Tamper-evident log of every mutating action (searches, exports, AI runs, deletions). Each entry is SHA-256 hash-chained to the previous — later edits are detected.

case_detail.ai_hint: Logically link this case's findings with AI (suggestions only — nothing is saved automatically).
case_detail.ai_disclaimer: AI-generated suggestions — please verify. Add them to the graph with one click.
case_detail.ai_added: Added to the graph — both nodes are now on the map.
case_detail.confirm_delete_entity_body: "{{label}}" will be deleted from this case along with every edge that touches it. This cannot be undone.
case_detail.map_empty: No geolocated entities in this case yet. Locations come from e.g. Telegram geo or (once enabled) Google Maps reviews.
case_detail.export_hint: Placeholder nodes are never exported; source and rating travel with the finding.
case_detail.graph_busy: This case holds {{n}} nodes — the canvas may become sluggish
case_detail.graph_busy_hint: The graph is loaded and drawn in full; nothing is omitted. For very large cases it helps to work from the findings list and mark irrelevant nodes as false positives.
case_detail.unrated_legacy: {{n}} findings in this case carry no source rating
case_detail.unrated_legacy_hint: They were collected before the Admiralty scale was introduced. This is not a judgement about the source — re-running the search on the same selector fills the rating in.
case_detail.ai_added_partial: Link saved, but not all nodes could be put on the map — the graph may therefore not show them.
case_detail.fallback_desc: The customer's data store could not be reached, so these findings come from the framework's own copy. They may be incomplete or out of date — do not treat this view as the full case.

case_phase.new_hint: The case exists. First step: search a selector or paste the report.
case_phase.collecting_hint: Search selectors, take findings into the case, work through the open selectors.
case_phase.analysing_hint: Assess findings, check connections, build the picture on the map.
case_phase.reporting_hint: Produce the report, export, put it on file.
case_phase.note: The phase is a note about your work, not a rule — you can go back at any time, and nothing is locked by it.

cases.load_failed_hint: This says nothing about your cases — the list simply could not be retrieved. Please try again.

dashboard.alerts_tooltip: Changes monitoring found since you last looked. A monitor's first run reports nothing — it records what was already there.
dashboard.load_failed_hint: The figures shown may be incomplete. This says nothing about your cases — some data simply could not be fetched.
dashboard.no_cases: No cases yet — start your first OSINT search.
dashboard.running_tooltip: Search runs still working in your cases. Open one to follow its progress tool by tool.

delta.load_failed: The additions could not be loaded.
delta.no_search_yet: No search has been run on this case yet.
delta.nothing_new: The last run added nothing new — existing findings were re-confirmed.
delta.compared_to: Compared with the previous run: “{{query}}” of {{when}}
delta.first_run: First run on this case — everything is new.
delta.additions_only: Additions only. Whether a source stopped returning something is not tracked.
delta.boundary_hint: Cut-off: everything stored since {{when}}. Re-confirmed findings do not count as additions.

digest.title: Situation report
digest.kev_none: No new entries in this window.
digest.scope: Public sources only — press, CISA KEV and ransomware leak-site postings. Nothing here is derived from case data.
digest.failed_hint: This says nothing about the situation — only that the report could not be reached just now. Please try again.
digest.note_kev_unavailable: CISA KEV unreachable — the exploited-vulnerability section is missing from this edition.
digest.note_ransomware_no_key: ransomware.live: no key configured — the victims section needs the free PRO key.
digest.note_ransomware_bad_response: ransomware.live returned an unexpected non-JSON response.

digest.window_independent: — independent of the selected time window

drift.title: Reconciliation with the customer store
drift.intro: Compares this authority's cases with what its agent actually holds. Metadata only — no investigation content is retrieved.
drift.warn_head: These cases are unreachable for the authority — and are never auto-deleted
drift.warn_body: They exist only in the customer's store. Because auto-delete iterates framework cases, no retention period is ever evaluated here. The data outlives every retention rule with nobody able to see it.
drift.confirm_title: Delete this case in the customer store?
drift.confirm_desc: Irreversibly deletes {{e}} entities in the authority's store. The action is recorded in the authority's audit log.
drift.refused: Refused — the case exists in the framework; the ordinary delete handles those.
drift.fw_only_head: {{n}} cases with no counterpart on the agent
drift.fw_only_body: Usually harmless: a case never searched, or one created while the agent was unreachable. No data is being held that anyone would need to delete.

findings.remove_confirm_title: Remove {{count}} findings from the case for good?
findings.remove_confirm_body: The findings and their links will be deleted from the case. This cannot be undone. If you want the judgement to remain traceable, mark them as noise instead — that keeps the rows.

forums.headline: {{total}} forums in the pool · {{enabled}} active (search cap {{cap}})
forums.explain: The pool is a reference list; only the active ones are searched. Every forum hunt spends one search-engine query per active forum — more forums means more queries and a longer search, not automatically more hits.
forums.empty_hint: The list is empty — the module then uses its built-in list of {{n}} forums. Searching still happens, just on the defaults.
forums.over_cap: More active forums than the cap of {{cap}} — the module truncates the list and the surplus is NOT searched.
forums.seed_hint: Adds the {{n}} bundled forums. Existing entries are left untouched.
forums.bulk_hint: Applies to the {{count}} currently shown entries
forums.remove_confirm: Remove this forum from the list?
forums.add_hint: One domain per line or comma separated; full URLs are fine too. Anything after # is ignored. Whatever is not a valid domain is dropped — otherwise every search would query it for nothing.
forums.load_failed: Could not load the forum list
forums.check_index_hint: Asks the search engine how much of each forum it has indexed. Does NOT touch the forums — and answers the question that matters: the hunt asks a search engine, so an un-indexed forum yields nothing however alive it is.
forums.check_reach_hint: Fetches each forum over Tor — never from the operator's address. Separates "dead" from "alive but not letting us in". Slower than the index check.
forums.checked: {{n}} checked · indexed {{indexed}} · no index {{notIndexed}} · online {{online}} · refused {{blocked}}
forums.no_key: Without a BRAVE_API_KEY (tab "API keys") readability cannot be measured — and the clearnet hunt runs degraded too.
forums.cleanup_confirm: {{n}} forums with no index hits. Disable them (otherwise they cost one query per search and return nothing) or remove them entirely?
forums.st_indexed_hint: At least {{n}} pages of this forum are indexed — the sample was capped at 20, there may be more.
forums.st_not_indexed_hint: The search engine has nothing from this forum. Usually a login wall, a robots.txt or a bot defence — the forum hunt can get nothing here even if the forum is alive.
forums.idx_hint: Above are the domains a search queries through a search engine. Here are two pre-downloaded lookup tables the tools search locally — different source, different scope, no case link. They are rebuilt regularly; one at a time, because a rebuild is memory-heavy.
forums.idx_started: Rebuild started — running in the background
forums.idx_baked_hint: Still using the copy baked into the container at build time — so no refresh has ever completed. This marker disappears after the first successful run.
forums.idx_not_the_list: These numbers have nothing to do with the forum list above.
forums.idx_sources: Actor handles: public dataset (spmedia/Threat-Actor-Usernames-Scrape) · Board directory: link-base.ms
forums.idx_covers_hint: How many forums this dataset covers — independent of which forums are in the list above. They overlap; they are not the same set.
forums.ddcti_hint: Pulls the forum list from fastfire/deepdarkCTI (forum.md) — around 190 clearnet hosts and 60 onion addresses. New entries arrive DISABLED, or every hunt would fire hundreds of queries. The source's ONLINE/OFFLINE column is kept as a note, never as a filter: it lists xss.is as offline while it is running.
forums.ddcti_done: {{added}} newly imported ({{clearnet}} clearnet, {{onion}} onion) · {{total}} in the pool. All disabled — check first, then enable.
forums.onion_hint: Hidden service. Not searched — no clearnet index carries onion addresses. The entry exists so a darknet hit can be named instead of reported as an anonymous service.
forums.st_na_hint: Readability cannot be measured for a hidden service — no clearnet search engine indexes onion addresses. That is not a defect in the entry; the Tor reachability check still applies.
forums.check_access_hint: Fetches each forum’s root and member area over Tor and reports whether a guest can read anything there, plus which forum software it runs. Costs no query budget. NOTE: “login required” is a finding about the forum, not a task. Giving the framework an account is the authority’s decision with a legal shape, not a setting. 50 forums per run, never-checked first.
forums.checked_access: {{n}} checked · readable without login {{open}} · login required {{login}} · blocked {{blocked}}
forums.profile_by_id: profiles keyed on a numeric id — a per-handle check cannot work here
forums.recheck_hint: Re-probes exactly those entries whose last answer says nothing (no answer, unknown) — fewest probes first. Needed because a single Tor probe only describes one circuit: the same host was measured flipping between "no answer" and "blocked" between two runs on the same day. Only repeated probes separate a hard-to-reach forum from a dead one.

settings.ai_balance_note: Remaining credit is not retrievable via the Gemini API key (it lives in Google Cloud Billing). Shown here are exact token counts; the cost is an estimate using the rates above — check the real balance in the Google billing dashboard.
settings.ai_maxent_desc: How many of the most-relevant case entities are sent to the AI. Higher = more context but slower/costlier; lower = faster. Range 10–500, default 150.
settings.ghunt_derived: Master token derived and filled in above — now Save
settings.ghunt_hint: Click the Companion extension in a browser logged into the burner Google account → paste its base64 block here. The server derives the long-lived master token and fills it in above. Then Save + Test.
settings.intro: Operator-global keys shared across all authorities. Saved here they take effect immediately (no restart); .env values are used as a fallback.
settings.n8n_desc: Turns outside access to the n8n editor (…/n8n/) on or off. n8n keeps running — only the public route is blocked; internal automations/webhooks are unaffected.
settings.note: These are the framework operator's own provider accounts — not tenant data. Every authority's searches use these shared keys.
settings.placeholder: Leave blank to keep current value
settings.tg_hint: Paste a StringSession (scripts/telegram-session.py). Activating it for collection needs a module restart.
settings.title: API Keys & Integrations

harvest.title: News harvester (background fetch)
harvest.run_hint: Fetches every enabled feed immediately, ignoring the schedule.
harvest.run_done: Harvest done: {{inserted}} new articles ({{fetched}} feeds fetched).
harvest.enabled_hint: Off = no automatic fetch (the button still fetches).
harvest.no_retention_hint: Articles are never deleted. That is deliberate — an article deleted after 90 days is one nobody can cite any more. But it means this table grows forever; the projection next to it says how fast.

feeds.cfg_age_hint: Older entries are ignored. 0 = no limit.
feeds.cfg_entries_hint: Substituted for {{ph}} in the feed URL (e.g. end_index={{ph}}).
feeds.cfg_results_hint: How many articles the investigator gets to see.
feeds.empty_desc: While the list is empty the module uses its built-in, verified defaults. As soon as you add feeds here, only this list applies.
feeds.group_empty: No feeds in this group yet.
feeds.howto_1: 1. Find the RSS/Atom address on the source's website (often under «RSS» or «Feed», otherwise in the page source as link rel=alternate).
feeds.howto_2: 2. Click «Add here» in the matching group, enter name and URL, then hit the test button. Green with a number = the feed returns entries.
feeds.howto_3: 3. If the URL contains a count (e.g. end_index=200), replace it with {{ph}} — then the «Entries per feed» field drives every feed at once:
feeds.intro: RSS/Atom sources searched by the "News & RSS" module, grouped by source kind. Changes take effect on the next search, no restart. Add new feeds via "Add here" in the matching group and check them with the test button.
feeds.load_failed: Could not load the feed list
feeds.test_all_hint: Tests every feed in this group one after another (not in parallel, to avoid hammering the sources).
feeds.url_required: Every row needs a feed URL

audit.boundary: This is the operator's action log only. The authorities' own audit trails live in their systems and are neither visible nor retrievable here.

graph.admiralty_hint: Admiralty rating: source reliability A–F, information credibility 1–6. “1” is only assigned when two or more independent tools agree.
graph.canvas_keys: Arrow keys pan, plus and minus zoom, zero fits everything into view.
graph.canvas_label: Relationship graph with {{count}} nodes, graphical view
graph.no_data: No data — run a search to build the network
graph.no_selection: Click a node to see its details
graph.notes_placeholder: Your own assessment of this node — stored with the customer and printed in the case file.
graph.path_none: No connection in the visible graph
graph.placeholder_hint: Edge endpoint no tool has confirmed as a finding.

graph_map.empty: Nothing on the map yet. Add findings with the “+ Map” button — connected entities link up automatically.
graph_map.link_pending: Link pending — from “{{label}}”. Right-click the target.
graph_map.link_custom: Pick one or type your own
graph_map.link_duplicate: This link already exists — same direction, same kind.
graph_map.link_existing: These two are already linked {{count}} time:
graph_map.link_existing_plural: These two are already linked {{count}} times:
graph_map.link_note: A link you draw is your assessment, not a statement by a source. It is stored as such and drawn dashed in the graph.
graph_map.unlink_confirm_body: The link “{{relation}}” you drew yourself will be removed from the case. Both nodes stay.
graph_map.edge_bundle_hint: Bundle of {{count}} links — expand the group to work on individual ones
graph_map.legend_bundle: thick = bundled links of a collapsed group
graph_map.select_hint: Drag on empty canvas to select several · middle mouse button pans

import_sel.title: Import from text
import_sel.privacy_head: The text stays in your browser
import_sel.privacy: The pasted text is never stored and never transmitted. It is parsed locally; only the selectors you tick below enter the case. Case files and attachments do not belong in this system.
import_sel.placeholder: Paste a report, complaint, alert or note here — numbers, addresses, aliases, wallets and links are detected.
import_sel.nothing_found: Nothing usable detected. Selectors can still be entered by hand.
import_sel.after_hint: Added selectors appear in the case and under “Open selectors” — nothing is searched until you start it.
import_sel.decoded_hint: This value was not in the visible text — it came out of a base64 or hex block inside the pasted text. The decoding also happened entirely in the browser.
import_sel.not_searchable_hint: No module available to you accepts this selector type. It can still be stored as case knowledge — there is just no search to run on it.
import_sel.qr_hint: You can also paste a screenshot — any QR code in it is read in the browser and its content inserted here. The picture itself is never uploaded or stored.
import_sel.qr_scanning: Reading QR code in the browser …
import_sel.qr_none: No QR code found in this image.

monitoring.qc_email_prefilled: Pre-filled from your tenant default (Settings → default alert email).
monitoring.new_picker_help: Pick the case this monitoring belongs to and paste the entity UUID. Faster path: right-click an entity in a case's graph and choose "Add to monitoring".
monitoring.new_picker_uuid_invalid: Must be a UUID (36 chars with hyphens)
monitoring.purpose_hint: Applies to every automatic rescan of this watch and is stored only in your authority's search log.
monitoring.selector_unknown: No search term could be determined for this entity — a watch without one would never run.
monitoring.trigger_new_edge: New connection of the watched entity
monitoring.triggers_empty_all: No selection = alert on every change.
monitoring.triggers_dropped: This watch contained triggers that can never fire and were removed: {{list}}. The platform keeps no earlier profile states and cannot tell a deleted profile from a failed lookup.

news.ai_hint: Analyses the news matching the keyword with AI: extracts names, usernames, e-mails, locations etc., summarises, and proposes case additions.
news.ai_pick_case: Pick a target case above to add suggestions.
news.ai_pick_some: Please select at least one entity.
news.ai_sovereignty: Only public news content is sent to the AI — never case data.
news.ai_applied: Added {{e}} entities and {{x}} connections to the case.
news.ai_timeout: The AI took too long. Try again with a more focused keyword.
news.ai_not_licensed: The AI function is not licensed for this authority.
news.add_hint: Opens the normal search with this term so the hits land as nodes in a case.
news.browse_intro: Search the configured RSS sources from authorities, police, media and cyber services. Nothing is stored — take relevant finds into a case afterwards.
news.hint: The "News & RSS" module is already selected. Enter a term, narrow it if useful (e.g. Schweiz, Zürich) — hits appear in the case with date, source and source kind.
news.intro: Searches the RSS feeds of authorities, police, media and cyber sources maintained in the Owner console.
news.no_hits: No hits in the searched sources.

news.licence_failed: The licence status could not be retrieved. If AI analysis is enabled for your authority, it will appear after a reload.

next_step.start_why: No findings yet. Two ways in: search a selector, or paste the report and take over the selectors it contains.
next_step.triage_why: Assess what is already here first — mark as relevant or remove as a false positive. It sharpens everything after it and shortens the list of open selectors.
next_step.selectors_why: These values are in the case but nobody has searched for them. Unsearched does not mean there is something there — only that nobody has asked.
next_step.report_why: Every selector in the case has been searched and assessment has begun. That does not mean the investigation is complete — only that nothing outstanding is visible here.

notify.events_hint: Nothing selected means every available trigger.
notify.events_section: What do you want to hear about?
notify.health_hint: These come from the server, not from this session: you will still see them tomorrow in a new window.
notify.no_default_recipient: none set — configure it under Settings
notify.privacy_body: Notifications deliberately carry no findings, only a count, the kind of change and a link into the application. A mail server sits outside your sovereign boundary; the findings themselves stay behind your own login.
notify.privacy_title: What a notification contains — and what it does not
notify.saved: Settings saved. Whether a message arrives is shown by the test, not by this.
notify.secret_stored: Stored — leave empty to keep it unchanged.
notify.test_hint: Only the test proves a message arrives — saving proves the form was valid.
notify.test_unreachable: The application could not run the test.
notify.unavailable_title: These triggers are gone because they could never have worked
notify.unregistered: This tenant is not registered with the licence server. Settings can be viewed but not saved — please contact the operator.
notify.verify_tls_hint: Switch off only for an internal relay with a self-signed certificate. An unverified TLS session looks encrypted on this screen but is not protected against an interceptor.
notify.webhook_secret_hint: Your receiver uses it to check the X-OSINT-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256 over "timestamp.body"). Without a secret it cannot tell our POST from anyone else's.
notify.webhook_url_hint: Must be a publicly reachable https address. A receiver inside the operator's network is refused.

pivot.title: Advanced search
pivot.hint: Pick a search value + tools and search. Hits are only added to the case if you select and add them. Note: the run consumes source query quota — even if you then add nothing.
pivot.not_pivotable: This entry can't be used as a search value
pivot.depth_hint: Search depth: how many tools run. Quick = seconds, Standard = one to three minutes, Thorough = includes the long sweeps.

report.title: Generate PDF report
report.lang_info: Report will be rendered in {{lang}} (matches your current UI language).
report.section_cover: Cover page (logo, case number, title, status)
report.section_graph_snapshot: Graph (rendered image of the case network)
report.only_relevant_hint: Tables, graph and evidence then show only the marked findings and the links between them. Every page says "Extract", so the report is not mistaken for the whole case.
report.docx_hint: Word file for further editing. Content and pictures as in the PDF; page layout, colours and the graph are simpler.

search.context_field_tooltip: Additional identifier — improves accuracy when modules support it. The current backend search uses only the main query field; multi-identifier search ships in a future release.
search.email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address
search.facets_hint: Each narrowing term starts an additional search run with that term appended — e.g. "Crimson Wolves" + "Zürich" also searches "Crimson Wolves Zürich". You can type your own terms. All hits are merged into the same case.
search.facets_placeholder: e.g. Schweiz, Zürich, Europa — or your own term
search.module_corporate_desc: Commercial registers, group structure, sanctions lists, directories — starting from a name rather than a technical selector
search.module_darknet_desc: Tor hidden services (Torch/TorDex) and paste sites
search.module_forums_desc: Cybercrime forums: username hunt + LinkBase directory (clearnet + darknet/Tor)
search.module_image_desc: EXIF/GPS extraction + AI location estimate from images
search.module_infra_desc: Domain/IP recon: subdomains, WHOIS, DNS, CT logs
search.module_leaks_desc: Email in data leaks and account footprint
search.module_messenger_desc: Telegram channels, search and Discord servers
search.module_news_desc: Searches press releases from authorities, police, media and cyber sources (RSS/Atom).
search.module_telegram_desc: Authenticated Telegram collection: channel scan, user/phone/geo lookup
search.module_threat_desc: IOC reputation: VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, URLhaus, GreyNoise
search.note_not_saved: The note could not be saved to the case — the search is running anyway. Please keep the text and enter it again.
search.notes_placeholder: Appended to case description with timestamp + your username
search.pb_hint: Presets the modules that fit this offence type. Fully adjustable afterwards.
search.pb_not_for_type: Not intended for this selector type
search.title: New OSINT Search
search.tool_address_risk_desc: Checks an EVM address (0x…) against the known-malicious address collections of SlowMist, BlockSec, OFAC and Chainabuse: sanctions, mixers, money laundering, darknet transactions, extortion, theft, phishing and more. No key needed. EVM only — for Bitcoin use sanctions screening or RansomLook.
search.tool_aircraft_sanctions_desc: Checks a registration (e.g. EP-GOL) against the OFAC SDN list (342 aircraft). Returns model, operator and serial numbers — the manufacturer's serial survives a re-registration, the tail number does not.
search.tool_asn_lookup_desc: Who carries this address: announcing AS, holder, prefix. Keyless (RIPEstat).
search.tool_code_scan_desc: Reads QR codes, DataMatrix, Aztec and barcodes out of an image and turns the content into usable selectors: a payment QR becomes a wallet address, a phishing QR a URL, a signature QR a Telegram channel. Free text stays on the code node and is not scattered into the graph.
search.tool_court_decisions_desc: Full-text search across all federal and cantonal court decisions. A hit is a mention in the text, not an identification — the PDF travels as the citation. Keyless.
search.tool_cve_lookup_desc: NVD detail plus whether the flaw is known to be exploited in the wild (CISA KEV). Keyless.
search.tool_discord_deep: Discord Deep (ID → full profile, badges; bot token)
search.tool_dom_hash_pivot_desc: Hashes the page structure and finds every host serving the identical page. Complements the favicon pivot for the common case where a burned operator swaps the icon but leaves the kit itself untouched. The hash and the dork are always produced; listing the hosts needs a paid Shodan account.
search.tool_finma_warnlist_desc: The Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority's public list of firms and websites offering financial services without the required authorisation (2302 entries since 2009). A hit is a statement by a federal authority, not an indication. The full-text search also matches address and remarks — every result records which field the term was found in. Keyless.
search.tool_geo_ch_desc: Address or place name to coordinates, municipality and canton — and coordinates back to the nearest registered building with its E-GRID parcel. Official federal geodata, keyless.
search.tool_gleif_lei_desc: Who owns whom: parents and subsidiaries across jurisdictions, including name variants in other scripts. Keyless.
search.tool_handle_sweep_desc: Runs the account sweep over the handle AND its plausible variants (d4rkc1ph3r / darkcipher / dark_cipher). Slow — several full sweeps. Accounts found under a variant are candidates, not identifications.
search.tool_lobbywatch_ties_desc: Which member of the federal parliament is attached to this company — and whom they let into the Bundeshaus. 243 parliamentarians, 973 lobbyists, 10,215 organisations, 7,581 interest ties and 334 access badges, each marked declared or **undeclared**. 6,356 organisations carry their UID and therefore merge with the register data. Keyless.
search.tool_news_search_desc: Full-text search across the RSS feeds maintained in the Owner console. Hits carry date, source and source kind (authority/police/media/cyber).
search.tool_passive_dns_desc: Historical resolutions: which domains pointed at this IP, and when. Keyless (mnemonic).
search.tool_ransomlook_crypto_desc: Wallet addresses attributed to a named ransomware group, with balance and transaction count. Forward direction only — "who owns this wallet" is still answered by wallet attribution in the crypto module.
search.tool_ransomlook_search_desc: Searches the term on RansomLook: ransomware groups, underground markets, leak-site posts and the text of ransom notes. Answers, among other things, "who writes this ransom note". Keyless, data CC BY 4.0.
search.tool_ransomware_watch_desc: Leak-site victims and groups incl. onion addresses (ransomware.live). Keyless tier: 1 request/minute.
search.tool_sanctions_screen_desc: Straight against EU FSF and OFAC SDN, no aggregator. Deliberately no fuzzy matching. Keyless.
search.tool_shab_registry_desc: Official publications: officers, signing authority, UID, seat, deletions. Primary record, keyless.
search.tool_staatskalender_desc: The Federal Chancellery's own register: does this person really hold the office they claim? Name → function, division, department, office phone, building and room. Also in reverse: office → staff, phone number → office, mail domain → every unit on it. Keyless, with a negative control on every run.
search.tool_tel_search_ch_desc: Public Swiss address and phone entries for a company or person. Keyless.
search.tool_telegram_deep_search_desc: Server-side search across given channels ("@chan1,@chan2 :: keyword")
search.tool_telegram_deeplink_search_desc: Builds deep links to Telegram channels and searches. It does not discover channels — global search or the authenticated Telegram module does that.
search.tool_telegram_phone_lookup_desc: Resolve a phone number to a Telegram account
search.tool_telegram_scan_desc: Full messages, members, admins, media, forwards, IOCs
search.tool_vessel_sanctions_desc: Checks a vessel name, IMO or MMSI number against the OFAC SDN list (1540 vessels). Returns flag state, owner, call sign, type and tonnage. The IMO check digit is verified first — a typo is refused rather than answered with "not listed".
search.tool_visual_geolocate: AI image geolocation (estimate location from image content)
search.tool_wikidata_entity_desc: Holdings, officers and owners from the open knowledge base. A lead, not a record.
search.tool_zefix_registry_desc: Current state of all 26 cantonal commercial registers: purpose, capital, previous names, branch offices, takeovers, auditor. Complements shab_registry, which carries the publications. Key required (free).
search.tools_none_selected: No tool selected — the search would query nothing.
search.purpose_hint: Stored only in your authority's search log, not with the operator. The last purpose used in a case is suggested again.
search.purpose_required: Your authority requires a purpose or legal basis for every search.
search.activity_log_unavailable: Your authority's search log is unreachable right now. Because a purpose is required, the search was not started.
search.start_failed: The search could not be started.
search.module_dating_desc: Opt-in username sweep across dating and adult platforms. ⚠️ Hits concern a person's sex life (special category of personal data) — use only with a legal basis.
search.tool_cupidcrawl_desc: Checks about 50 dating and adult platforms for the username; every hit is verified against a negative control. ⚠️ Special-category data (sex life) — use only with a specific legal basis and purpose, and keep results confidential.
search.tool_origin_resolve_desc: Finds the real address of a site behind Cloudflare & co. — and proves it: every candidate from SPF, MX, certificate transparency and DNS history is probed directly with the domain's Host header and checked against a negative control. Only confirmed hits are reported. Keyless. Off by default: probes candidate addresses directly from this server, including third-party servers.
search.tool_onion_scrape_desc: Fetches a hidden service over Tor and extracts email, Jabber, Tox and Session IDs, crypto addresses, PGP keys and links to other onion services. Text only, no media. Services on Ahmia's abuse blacklist are never fetched. Off by default. Nothing is fetched if the blacklist cannot be loaded.

search_progress.title: Search Progress
search_progress.polling_note: Auto-refreshing every 3 seconds. The tool status table below shows what's running right now.
search_progress.cancel_confirm_body: Everything found so far stays in the case. Only the tools still running are stopped.
search_progress.cancel_done: Search stopped — the findings so far stay in the case.
search_progress.cancel_too_late: The search had already finished before the stop arrived.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Press one after the other, not together. Inside a text field every shortcut stays inert.

support.tenant_intro: Questions or requests? Open a ticket — you chat directly with the operator team.
support.delete_confirm: Delete ticket permanently? The whole thread is removed.

tgchan.headline: {{total}} channels in the pool · {{enabled}} active (sweep cap {{cap}})
tgchan.explain: The pool is a reference; only active channels are swept. Every username search sweeps the active ones, so more channels means a longer search, not automatically more findings.
tgchan.over_cap: More active channels than the cap of {{cap}} — the module truncates the list and the surplus is NOT searched.
tgchan.bulk_hint: Applies to the {{count}} rows currently shown
tgchan.add_hint: One per line or comma separated. @handle, handle or a t.me URL all work; # starts a comment. Anything invalid is dropped rather than stored.
tgchan.load_failed: Could not load the channel list
tgchan.checked: {{n}} checked · {{alive}} alive · {{dead}} without a public page
tgchan.cleanup_confirm: {{n}} channels have no public page. Disabling is safe — private channels look identical to deleted ones. Removing deletes them from the pool.
tgchan.src_hint: A GitHub repo link (every .md file is scanned) or a direct file URL. Discovered channels arrive disabled. Scanned automatically every hour.

timeline.headline: {{n}} findings with a source date · {{skipped}} without
timeline.explain: Only findings carrying a date FROM THE SOURCE are shown. Undated findings are deliberately not placed on the line — an invented position would be worse than a gap.
timeline.none_dated: No finding in this case carries a source date.
timeline.none_in_filter: Nothing of this type on the timeline. Reset the filter to see everything.

worklist.headline: {{searched}} selectors searched · {{count}} in this case never asked about
worklist.note: Unsearched does not mean there is something there. It only means nobody has asked.
worklist.all_done: Everything in this case has already been searched as a selector
worklist.from_relation_hint: No tool reported this value itself — it appeared as the far end of a relation (the counterparty of a transaction, the host an MX record points at). A valid selector, but less well supported.

activity.unavailable: The search log lives in your authority's data store, which is unreachable right now.
activity.empty: No logged searches in this case yet. (Searches made before the search log was introduced are not included.)
activity.purpose_from_watch: as stated when the watch was created

case_access.restricted_off_hint: Everyone in your authority sees this case. Switch on to restrict it to the people working it.
case_access.restricted_on_hint: Restricted: only the creator, the assignee, the members below and your authority's admins see the case — to everyone else it does not exist.
case_access.members_hint: Usernames as used to sign in. Colleagues who have never signed in can be added too.
case_access.members_locked: Only the person who created the case, or an admin, can change access.

evidence.intro: Saved pages: a full-page screenshot and an archive (MHTML, with images and styling), each with its SHA-256. Stored in your authority's data store; the operator knows only the hashes.
evidence.url_placeholder: Address of a page to save (.onion works too)
evidence.capturing: The page is being loaded in a browser and saved — an .onion page can take over a minute.
evidence.empty: No saved pages in this case yet.
evidence.node_hint: Loads the source page in a browser and files screenshot and archive, with hashes, under "Evidence".
evidence.err_no_url: There is no page to save for this entity.
evidence.err_blocked: This address is not loaded (internal or invalid address).
evidence.err_store: Your authority's data store is unreachable — nothing was saved.
evidence.err_capture: The capture service is unreachable right now.
evidence.err_load: The page could not be loaded (offline, blocked or too slow).
evidence.err_timeout: Timed out — the page took too long.
evidence.err_generic: The page could not be saved.

merge.button_hint: Fold other nodes of this case that denote the same thing into this one
merge.title: Merge nodes
merge.intro: These nodes will be merged into:
merge.pick: Pick the nodes that denote the same thing
merge.warning: Links, sources and notes move over, the names are kept as "Also known as", and future searches file their findings under the remaining node. This cannot be undone.
merge.err_store: Merging needs your authority's data store, which is not set up.

case_template.label: Template (offence type)
case_template.hint: Preselects the matching playbook in search, gives the report a matching outline and shows the typical next tools. Everything stays changeable.
case_template.tag_tooltip: This case's template. Typical next tools: {{tools}}. Click to open search.

cross.banner: {{n}} finding(s) of this case also occur in {{cases}} other case(s).
cross.node_hint: The same finding is also in case "{{title}}". Click to open it.

selftest.failed: The self-test could not be run.
selftest.overall_warn: Working — but at least one item needs attention soon.
selftest.overall_fail: At least one part is not working. Details below.
selftest.license_warn: Expires on {{until}} — {{days}} days left. Please renew with the operator.
selftest.license_fail_expired: Expired or suspended (since {{until}}). Searches are blocked — please contact the operator.
selftest.license_fail_not_registered: No licence is registered for your authority — please contact the operator.
selftest.license_fail_unreachable: The operator's licence service does not answer.
selftest.agent_fail_unreachable: Unreachable. Is the server running, and is its address registered correctly with the operator?
selftest.agent_fail_not_configured: No data store is registered for your authority.
selftest.agent_key_fail: Rejected — findings cannot be stored. The key in the data store and the operator's do not match (re-run install.sh / the licence handover).
selftest.tls_warn: Certificate expires on {{until}} — automatic renewal (Caddy) does not seem to work.
selftest.tls_fail_plain_http: The data store ({{host}}) is contacted without encryption. Please switch to https.
selftest.tls_info_internal: Internal network ({{host}}) — development setup without TLS.
selftest.audit_chain_fail: {{broken}} entries do not match the chain — the log was altered or damaged.
selftest.audit_chain_warn_unavailable: Cannot be checked — the data store predates the log (update.sh).
selftest.idp_fail_unreachable: Your sign-in service ({{url}}) is unreachable — nobody can sign in.
selftest.idp_fail_status: Your sign-in service answers with error {{status_code}}.
selftest.alerting_warn_none: No alert channel set up — watches report new findings only in the interface. Set one up under "Alerting".
selftest.capture_warn: Currently unavailable — pages cannot be saved (operator informed?).

update.title: New version of your data store available: {{latest}} (installed: {{installed}})
update.how: Run on the server of your data store:
update.safety: update.sh verifies checksums, backs up the database first and rolls back automatically on failure. Check the "Self-test" afterwards.
update.header_tooltip: Version {{latest}} of your data store is available — details under Admin.

changelog.title: Release notes
changelog.intro: What changed in the platform, from the first version to the upcoming one. Security improvements are described by their effect, not in detail.
